why: UNESCO's dated country profile is the authoritative statement of the current position: no AI-specific laws or regulations, no National AI Ethics Commission, with the data-protection law and ANPDP named as the only relevant anchors.

The STP-specific AI Readiness Assessment is the fullest authoritative account of whether national AI systems exist; already staged by a sibling slice, so topped up with the tech.ai topic rather than restaged.
The signed agreement to build DireitosAoPovo.st is the only concrete in-window development of an AI system for the Santomean state, with a chatbot trained on national legislation.
The government's own data strategy and roadmap is the state's standing position on AI applied to public data in the administration; a national instrument rather than commentary.
AI deployed into a Santomean state function, with the Ministry of Justice as partner and reports routed to the Judicial Police; the furthest-moving in-window event.
A distinct second event: training of public-administration leaders in practical public-sector AI. Already staged by a sibling slice, so topped up with the tech.ai topic rather than restaged.
The only documented AI system operating inside a Santomean sector operation, with an STP-specific pilot recorded; the national DHIS2-based health MIS carries no AI.

The national statistics office's own measurement of the domestic information and communication sector: 6 enterprises, 0.6 per cent of the total, 209 persons at service. The published figure beats every diagnostic about it.
The ministry's own record of the national startup competition and incubation intake, with the fund size, application volumes and the requirement that ideas be implemented in STP.
A completed in-window cycle with a stated position: second edition concluded, applications, cohort size and four funded projects named.
A distinct second event: the third edition launched under a new ministry lead and a new focus, with dated registration phases.
The ministry's own record of the REINA incubator network as physical hubs on both islands, describing the spaces, services and target users, with the network's São Tomé address.
The only dated in-window evidence that the REINA hub is operating, naming it as a physical intake point for the new programme cycle. One file answering two indicators.
